name: Cable Incline Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline facing a low pulley.
Lie chest down on the pad with feet braced and reach forward to grasp the handles.
Draw your elbows toward your sides to pull the handles back beside your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep the back of your neck aligned with your spine.
Keep your chest planted on the pad instead of lifting up to finish the row.
